Small paper plate (about 18–20 cm across) with about 8 pieces of sausage-like browned food, possibly chorizo or pork sausage chunks. Each piece is roughly 3–5 cm, at about 15–20 g each, so roughly 130 g in total. At sausage density of about 300 kcal per 100 g, that comes to about 390 kcal. If the pieces are meatballs or roasted potatoes instead, the energy would be lower. The reddish color suggests chorizo or sausage, so I'll estimate a slightly more conservative 340 kcal.
